artifacts.title: A personal sound diary
artifacts.content: Make a small tool for recording short field sounds into a personal sound diary. Save each clip with a place label so the creator can revisit it later.

artifacts.title: One-touch capture
artifacts.content: The phone prototype opens directly to recording, then lets one person title a clip, inspect its waveform, and add a location label.

artifacts.title: Find a remembered sound
artifacts.content: A usability test focused on finding a sound in the creator's own archive by date and place. Listening and organizing are still individual activities.

artifacts.title: Game audio collaborators
artifacts.content: Two independent game-audio collaborators asked to exchange reusable field recordings, tag their mood and environment, and check whether a sound effect already exists.

artifacts.title: Shared sound collections
artifacts.content: The new prototype lets a small audio team search a shared sound collection by environment and mood, add credits, and assemble a scene-specific sound set.

artifacts.title: Roomtone library preview
artifacts.content: The preview organizes reusable field recordings into a searchable library for collaborators. Recording on a phone remains the simple way to add a new sound.
